lines.text: I think I'm coming down with a cold.

data.define: To begin to feel ill with something like a cold.

example.text: I think I'm coming down with a cold.

misuse.text: Don't say you 'came down with' a gift.
misuse.why: It means starting to get sick.

data.l1_hook: Mein Hals tut weh. Uh‑oh! ("come down with")
data.l1_ex: Ich glaube, ich bekomme eine Erkältung. ("come down with")
